body:
I slightly chewed the 5-Meo-BFE on a full stomach. The first effect was a feeling of love and to contact my friends by PC. While I was in a discussion I understood that I couldn't read anymore: that was after 45min or more from the realization. I felt also weak like having low blood pressure, so I lie in bed.
There I became calm and started to see strange forms, brown-coloured canyons, yes they seemed rounded rocks and canyons, and I was convinced that I was looking into a part of my brain.
Then I got up after a while (1 hour?) and I come back to my PC. The experience was pleasant above all because nobody could see me in bed, I was really out of reality, and because it didn't last too long.
[Reported Dose: 25mg - 30mg]
